notes.title: Elems now available on Steam!
notes.notes:
Dear friends!
We are glad to announce, that our game [b]Elems[/b] is already available for purchasing at Steam only for $0.99!
Buy it and start collecting the Shards of the Life Ball at all of its 32 levels!
Have a nice play!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/528670
